hud.name: Industrial Command
hud.direction: Tactile industrial command screen: pale concrete arena tiles, graphite machinery, sparse cyan player energy and orange hazard accents. Compact top telemetry strip; three square tower controls at bottom left and one broad launch control bottom right. Beveled metal separators, small stamped numerals, and a restrained perimeter of damaged facility material. Near-orthographic shallow relief, not photorealism. Make the board and bottom command dock feel like one instrument.

hud.name: Survey Table
hud.direction: Bright cartographic tactical table, almost white terrain with crisp black topographic contours and sparse green infestation. A very narrow vertical telemetry strip sits outside the board at left; pause and settings are upper right. Under the arena, a right-aligned vertical launch/status pair meets a left horizontal row of three tower icons. Flat diagrammatic machinery, red threats and mineral-green player identifiers. No glow or chunky tile bevels.

hud.name: Arcade Circuit
hud.direction: Graphic arcade energy on a near-black physical circuit-board surface. Crisp cyan rail traces, coral threats, yellow planning marks, subtle gray cell dividers; no bloom cloud. A single clean score strip across the top. Bottom controls form three large tactile symbol keys with a thin full-width launch bar immediately below. Sharp geometric tower silhouettes and restrained luminous projectile lines give Geometry Wars-like clarity without copying its assets.

hud.name: Ceramic Outpost
hud.direction: Premium white ceramic technology against a quiet gray-green alien field. Dark seams and vermilion enemy organisms, mint weapon cores. Shallow sculpted terrain rather than a wire grid. Top HUD grouped into one thin left statistics ledger and a compact right utility pair. Beneath the board, tower choices are flush square ceramic insets and a separated central launch button occupies the lowest thumb zone. Soft lighting but crisp outlines.

hud.name: Vector Alloy
hud.direction: Faceted low-poly alloy towers and flat-shaded cool gray rock, with acid-green systems and saturated red Brood. Thin clipped-corner brackets define the arena without a surrounding panel. The top uses a narrow centered wave meter with lives and credits at opposite ends. A single bottom utility ribbon combines tower symbols, a clear vertical separator, launch arrow, and status; no separate floating buttons. Graphic, angular, disciplined.

hud.name: Field Instrument
hud.direction: Rugged scientific field instrument: neutral charcoal casing, silver terrain, white markings, emergency red and sulfur-yellow accents. Three compact gauge-like statistics across the upper edge, with digital values perfectly readable. Below the board, large square tower keys sit left while launch and pause share a clearly separated right-hand column. Stencil-like technical markings and sparse broad machinery shapes; not a military realism simulator.

hud.name: Containment Habitat
hud.direction: A shallow cutaway biotech containment floor, pearl-gray walkable plates, small moss-green organic veins at the perimeter, crimson threats and teal machinery. Calm top readout integrated into a narrow architectural lintel. A stepped but compact bottom command shelf puts tower symbols on the upper row, a wide central launch control beneath, and small utility symbols at the outer corners. Organic world versus engineered HUD, clear and restrained.

hud.name: Orbital Minimal
hud.direction: Minimal orbital laboratory: snow-white interface, graphite type, pale steel arena with blue-black void visible only at the perimeter, gold objectives and turquoise defenses. Small circular metric indicators at upper corners around a centered wave label. Bottom tower controls spread evenly in a shallow arc, with a centered rectangular launch control below. Extremely economical visual chrome, strong negative space inside cells, clean solid machinery.

hud.name: Signal Print
hud.direction: Bold flat screen-printed science fiction: white and charcoal blocks, coral enemy forms and clear green player forms. No gradients, bevels, bloom, or realistic materials. Terrain is a crisp geometric field with lightly stippled hard cells. Typography is assertive but compact. A top rule separates statistics; the lower controls form two unequal bands, tower-choice symbols above a full-width split launch/status strip. Strongest high-contrast editorial direction.

hud.name: Frontier Diorama
hud.direction: Stylized miniature frontier battlefield viewed almost straight down: quiet light-gray rock slabs, desaturated vegetation, mint-white machinery and brick-red Brood. Shallow soft shadows give solidity without hiding cells; not glossy toy plastic. A narrow top status banner and an asymmetrical lower command deck: three substantial tower buttons on the left, prominent launch on the right, fine wave-status track below. The landscape carries personality while the HUD stays clean.
